reading.zh: 从左到右：样式脚手架 → 生成/修订脚本（doc-builders 生成 Learn 下的既有手册，setting-panel-doc 生成 Assets/Story 下的设置面板说明）→ 自检脚本回查产物。
reading.en: Left to right: style scaffold, then the builder/patcher scripts that write the Learn manuals (doc-builders for the existing manuals, setting-panel-doc for the settings-panel doc in Assets/Story), then the self-check that reads the output back.
